name: MajorMUD-Reforged Librarium Canonical Manifest
governing_rule: The Librarium is the canonical source of truth. Runtime data, server data, editor data, documentation exports, validation reports, and AI/world overlays are generated from or linked back to Librarium records.

consumer_policy.runtime: Consumes generated outputs from Librarium; does not define canonical game truth.
consumer_policy.server: Executes and hosts generated runtime data; does not invent independent game logic.
consumer_policy.editor: Edits Librarium records/overlays, then regenerates outputs.
consumer_policy.validation: Validates Librarium records, relationships, assertions, generated outputs, and evidence transitions.
consumer_policy.ai_worlds: Use overlay graphs and proposal records; never overwrite Classic canonical records directly.

librariumAuthority: Librarium is the source of truth; /Data is generated runtime output.
importedDatabasesPolicy: Retain /ImportedDatabases until Librarium is 100% complete and user explicitly approves retirement.
baseline: CodeUpdate 0118 - Librarium Baseline Cleanup and Import Retention
dataPolicy: /Data is generated output per world and should not be hand-edited as canonical source.
hostClientPolicy: Host/server/editor may edit validated Librarium worlds; client is read-only by connected world.
